from collections import Counter
import json
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cs=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]]
    ys=[c[0] for c in cs]; xs=[c[1] for c in cs]
    t_,l_,b_,r_=min(ys),min(xs),max(ys),max(xs)
    cnt=Counter(c[2] for c in cs)
    inner=cnt.most_common()[-1][0]
    icells=[c for c in cs if c[2]==inner]
    ivs=[c[0] for c in icells]; ixs=[c[1] for c in icells]
    ih,iw=max(ivs)-min(ivs)+1,max(ixs)-min(ixs)+1
    m=(ih+iw)//4+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(max(0,t_-m),min(h,b_+m+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,l_-m),min(w,r_+m+1)):
            out[i][j]=inner
    for i,j,v in cs: out[i][j]=v
    return out

def minority_color(grid):
    """The least common nonzero color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v).most_common()[-1][0]


def shape_bbox(grid):
    """Bounding box (top, left, bottom, right) of the nonzero cells."""
    cs = [(i, j) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[i][j]]
    ys = [c[0] for c in cs]; xs = [c[1] for c in cs]
    return min(ys), min(xs), max(ys), max(xs)


def color_block_dims(grid, color):
    """(height, width) of the bounding box of all cells of the given color."""
    cs = [(i, j) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[i][j] == color]
    ys = [c[0] for c in cs]; xs = [c[1] for c in cs]
    return max(ys) - min(ys) + 1, max(xs) - min(xs) + 1

    t_, l_, b_, r_ = shape_bbox(grid)
